title: Gymdesk vs Kicksite: Pricing by Student Count (2026)
description: Gymdesk vs Kicksite for martial arts schools: $75-$240/mo vs $49-$199/mo by students, Basys $29/mo fee, websites, apps, texting and cancellation terms.
body:
Gymdesk and Kicksite both price martial arts software by how many active students you have, and both include every feature at every tier. The differences are in where the tiers break, how you take payments, and what happens around the software: Gymdesk includes a gym website and a native member app, while Kicksite includes free unlimited one-way texting and does your data import for you. Kicksite starts lower ($49/mo for 0-25 students) and tops out at a flat $199/mo for 101+ students. Gymdesk starts at $75/mo with Gymdesk Payments ($100/mo with your own processor) and climbs to $200-$240/mo at 151-250 members.

We checked both vendors' own pricing, feature, switching and terms pages on November 24, 2026. We haven't used either product ourselves and we don't publish ratings. Anything a vendor doesn't publish is marked unknown.

Kicksite's $29/mo is the monthly fee on Basys's flat-rate card plan, Kicksite's preferred US processor; the card + ACH plan is $49/mo plus a $35 setup fee instead. Gymdesk doesn't count visitors, frozen or cancelled members, or prospects as active members; Kicksite says its pricing is "based on active student count" but doesn't define it further on the pricing page. Kicksite also offers discounted annual pricing if you ask at a demo (amount not published). Sources: kicksite.com/pricing, kicksite.com/payment-processing and gymdesk.com/pricing, checked 2026-11-24.

Total monthly cost with card processing (illustration)

Software price alone hides the processing bill. As an illustration, assume every student pays $150 a month by domestic card in one charge. For Kicksite we use Basys's published flat rate ($29/mo + 2.9% + $0.25 per card transaction). For Gymdesk we use your own Stripe account at Stripe's standard published rate (2.9% + $0.30 per domestic card charge, no monthly fee), because Gymdesk doesn't publish the Gymdesk Payments rate.

The card percentage is the same 2.9% in both columns, so the gap comes from the software tiers, Basys's $29/mo fee and the per-charge fee ($0.25 vs $0.30). Gymdesk with Gymdesk Payments would be $25-$40/mo cheaper on software than the Gymdesk column above, but we can't total it without the rate, so ask Gymdesk for it in writing. Basys also offers a service-fee option where students pay an extra 3.75% per card payment and your net card fees are zero ($29/mo); check your state's surcharging rules before using it. Stripe rates from stripe.com/pricing, checked 2026-11-24. Your real cost depends on your card mix, family billing and any negotiated rate; the payment processing fees guide walks through the other fee models, and the membership revenue calculator helps estimate your monthly card volume.

More on apps in our branded app guide and on websites in martial arts software with a website included.

Switching in either direction

Kicksite offers a free data import: its in-house Data Specialist exports your data from your old system (Gymdesk is on its list) and imports it, usually in 2 business days or less once it has access, followed by 60 days of one-on-one onboarding with unlimited trainings. It imports profiles, guardians, program, rank and membership details, but not saved card or bank numbers, so families re-enter payment methods through bulk invites. It also doesn't bring over promotion or attendance history. Gymdesk says a specialist guides the switch, that saved card tokens can usually move between Stripe, Square or Authorize.net and Gymdesk Payments without members re-entering cards, and that you can export members, attendance history, payment records, waivers and documents yourself with no exit fee. Sources: kicksite.com/switch, Kicksite import list, gymdesk.com/pricing. Our switching guide covers card transfers and timelines in detail.

What Gymdesk claims about Kicksite (and what to check)

Gymdesk publishes its own Gymdesk vs Kicksite page. It says Kicksite's automations cover prospects only and come with message limits, and that Kicksite locks US and Canadian schools into Basys. That's a competitor's description. Kicksite's own pages call Basys its "preferred" US partner and Stripe its "preferred international" partner, describe automated messaging flows for prospects, and don't say whether other US processors are allowed or whether automations have limits. If either point matters to you, ask Kicksite at the demo and get the answer in writing.

Which to pick

Kicksite fits two ends of the range: a small school under 25 students ($49/mo) and a large school above 150 students, where its flat $199/mo for 101+ students beats Gymdesk's $200-$240/mo and Gymdesk's Enterprise quote above 250. It also suits owners who want the vendor to do the data import and want free one-way texting. Budget for the $29/mo Basys fee, the 30-day cancellation notice and non-refundable annual plans. Gymdesk fits schools of roughly 26-150 students, where its tiers cost less, and anyone who wants a website and a native member app included, more processor choices, month-to-month terms with no cancellation cost, or Smoothcomp competition tools for a BJJ team. Texting costs extra on Gymdesk, and you'll need to ask for the Gymdesk Payments rate. Both give you 30 days free, so you can run your real schedule in each before deciding. {{aff:gymdesk|Visit Gymdesk}} {{aff:kicksite|Visit Kicksite}}

faq: It depends on headcount. Kicksite is $49/mo for 0-25 students, $99 for 26-50, $149 for 51-100 and $199 for 101+. Gymdesk is $75/$100/$150/$200 a month with Gymdesk Payments for up to 50/100/150/250 active members ($25-$40 more with your own processor). Gymdesk costs less from about 26 to 150 students; Kicksite costs less under 25 and above 150 (kicksite.com/pricing, gymdesk.com/pricing, checked 2026-11-24).
What are Kicksite's payment processing fees?

Through Kicksite's preferred US partner Basys, the flat-rate card plan is $29/mo plus 2.9% + $0.25 per transaction. The card + ACH plan is a $35 setup fee, $49/mo, 2.9% + $0.25 per card and $0.30 per ACH transaction. International schools use Stripe (kicksite.com/payment-processing, checked 2026-11-24).
What is the Gymdesk Payments rate?

Gymdesk doesn't publish it. Using Gymdesk Payments (or an approved partner) lowers the software price by $25/mo ($40/mo on the 151-250 tier). Gymdesk also works with Stripe, Square, Authorize.net, GoCardless and Ezypay.
Gymdesk includes a responsive gym website on every plan. Kicksite builds websites (Basic, Advanced, Premium, Multi-Location) for software customers but doesn't publish prices.
Does either have a member app?

Gymdesk has a native member app, and a branded version with your own App Store and Google Play listing is $100/mo. Kicksite's Member Portal is a mobile web app with class registration, payment methods and a check-in barcode.

Kicksite includes free unlimited one-way texting. Gymdesk includes email and push notifications; SMS is a usage-based add-on with a monthly number fee and per-message rate that Gymdesk doesn't publish.

Gymdesk is month to month with no setup fee, minimum term or cancellation cost. Kicksite's terms ask for 30 days' written notice through the in-app form, say purchases are non-refundable, and say annual plans auto-renew and aren't refunded if cancelled early.
Will Kicksite move my students' saved cards from Gymdesk?

No. Kicksite imports profiles, guardians, program, rank and membership details for free, but not card or bank numbers; families re-enter payment methods through bulk invites. Gymdesk says it can usually move saved card tokens from Stripe, Square or Authorize.net.
